title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.18: Book of Order flank bosses now render with the FULL animated art of the boss each path leads to (like the second-boss node), and are properly selectable in normal play (previously only the debug-travel path worked). You can now read your ending straight off the map.
